title: Bosun Commonplace Work Contract v1
description: Machine-readable schema contract for a Commonplace (Realm 18: Media catalog) work note's YAML frontmatter. Authoritative records are CommonMark files at `locker_commonplace/works/<slug>.md`. External identifiers and `sources` URLs are preserved as references; adapters do not fetch them.

schema.description: Frontmatter type tag identifying this entity as a Commonplace work, schema version 1.

relations.description: Optional typed graph edges to related works, notes, or people.

$pkm.description: PKM envelope carrying the schema tag and optional graph relations.

medium.description: Primary medium of the catalogued work.

imdb.description: IMDb title identifier (tt followed by digits).

musicbrainz.description: MusicBrainz recording, release, or work MBID.

external_ids.description: Multi-service external identifiers. Unknown provider keys are preserved.

url.description: Reference URL. Not fetched by the gateway adapter.

kind.description: How the URL relates to the work.

sources.description: Reference sources for the work. URLs are stored, never retrieved by spec adapters.
